cycle._note: cycle volumes, settle_s, blank_drift_delta_e and phase budgets are pre-bring-up placeholders; on-rig bring-up replaces the budgets with measured phase timings + margin and settles the volumes against measured rinse efficacy. refill_ml + rinse_ml at 50+20 means 70 ml water drawn and 70 ml waste per cycle, under the spec's ~100 ml/cycle fair math: at reservoir_ml and waste_capacity_ml of 6000 the low-headroom trip fires around cycle 80, beyond the spec's 45-60. rinse_ml 20 is bench-verified sufficient (AL, 2026-07-24). drain_ml 75 covers refill 50 + up to 20 ml dye with margin and empties the 20 ml rinse; keep drain_ml >= refill_ml + max dye and >= rinse_ml or the cup never bookkeeps to empty. cup_ceiling_ml is pinned at 75 because config validation requires drain_ml >= cup_ceiling_ml (a full drain must always empty a full cup); it still clears worst-case fill (refill 50 + dye 20 = 70) but leaves only 5 ml of headroom, so blips during settle are limited to that headroom. phase_budgets_s are per-phase watchdog abort timeouts (a phase that exceeds its budget aborts the cycle and trips to paused), NOT pump on-time cutoffs -- the pump on-time cap is caps.max_relay_on_s.
